sloka: स तत् गृह्य हरिश्रेष्ठः स्थाप्य मूर्ध्नि कृतांजलिः ।वन्दित्वा चरणौ चैव प्रस्थितः प्लवगर्षभः ॥४-४४-१५॥
transliteration: sa tat gṛhya hariśreṣṭhaḥ sthāpya mūrdhni kṛtāṁjaliḥ ।vanditvā caraṇau caiva prasthitaḥ plavagarṣabhaḥ ॥4-44-15॥

translations.english: The foremost among the monkeys took the ring given to him, placed it on his forehead and saluated it with folded palms. He then prostrated at the feet of Rama and departed.
